SOL keeps the desire for more information in brisker wording.

SOL keeps the breath brushing his face and the close physical proximity.
SOL keeps the promise and the speaker’s intention to honor it later.

SOL preserves the shocked, speechless reaction.
SOL keeps the threat to lie if he can get away with it, in natural dialogue.
